title: QDC Quantum Farming 2.0
description: Quantum Particle Trees and Quantum Tool Crops that grow on a specific time. Crop Planter and Harvester, Tree Planter and Harvester for Automation.
body:
This is the Second Main Version of the QDC Quantum Farming Mod, it completely different from the First Version, it adds new trees, new crops and farming automation machines. This mod requires the Core Mod, QDC CORE 4.5

# New Quantum Particle Trees

This mod introduces 6 new Quantum Particle Trees. These trees grow on a fixed amount of time depending on the tree particle type. These trees only drop Quantum Particles depending on the tree particle type.
  
  ## Particle Tree Types
  
    - Nature Particle Tree
    - Food Particle Tree
    - Metal Particle Tree
    - Gem Particle Tree
    - Enchanted Particle Tree
    - Potion Particle Tree

  ## The Trees

![All Quantum Particle Tree Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a14e747d747a8699e2e07daf29c4768a5efc25e.png)

  ## The Saplings

![All Quantum Particle Tree Sapling Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe5cbbe7ceb90e0a96791181460c6e3ab9d0c290.png)
  
# New Quantum Tool Seeds & Crops

This mod introduces Quantum Tool Seeds, which are seeds made from tools, that will grow the tool used to make the Quantum Tool Seed. These crops grow on a fixed amount of time, depending on the durability of the item made into the seed. These seeds can be created in the QDC Quantum Farming 2.0 screen, found in the main menu of the Core Mod, QDC CORE 4.5.

  ## Functionality
  These crops generate virtual particles while they grow. The higher tier the tool used to make the seed, the more particles generated over time. If one harvest the crop before maturity, the Tool Seed and particles generated so far will be recieved. If Crop is harvested at full maturity, the tool item and particles genenrated will be recieved. Also at full maturity one recieves a bonus of 10% of the particles generated while crop was growing.

  ## Tool Seed Creation Screen

  In this screen you can only create tool seeds of the tools that have ben discovered in the Core Mod. Also the Particles from the Core Mod are required to create the tool seed. 

![Quantum Tool Seed Creation Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a175ed05a825e8761341e45cc884b9f85093358.png)

  ## Tool Crop

  After you plant the crop you will slowly see the tool growing. If you right click on the crop, it will show details on the crop.

![Quantum Tool Crop Netherite Axe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6068230500eba6b1fe613d4dbdcdba4bb675b66f.png)


# Farming Automation Machines

This mod introduces 4 machines for farming automation, This includes crop planting and harvesting machines and tree planting and harvesting machines. These machines use soem virtual nature particles from the core mod as fuel. The Planter machines use particles equal to the particle values assigned to the seed or sapling in the core mod, they use  particles each time a seed or sapling is planted.


## Crop Automation Machines
  
  These machines should work on any simple Crops and Seeds from any mod, they even work with the new Quantum Tool Seeds included in this mod.
  
  ### Crop Planter
  
  This machine requires the player to right click the machine with a Crop Seed to set it to the machine.

![Crop Planter Potato](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aedd79526f05d4ffc9a44229282cbdad9c181598.png)

![Crop Planter Iron Hoe Seed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8d7090f1aeb64eca5681fb22fcf17bdf3901279.png)

  ### Crop Harvester
  
  This machine will automatically detect any crop and harvest if at full maturity.

![Crop Harvester Potato](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc9fdd2e47ecad1ebfd24d1901cda5d29cfe70eb.png)

![Crop Harvester Iron Hoe Tool Crop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c84e0830b5a9374bbe6adb76de35087eb083a90.png)

## Tree Automation Machines
 These machines should work on any simple Trees and Saplings from any mod, they even work with the Quantum Particle Trees included in this mod..
  
  ### Tree Planter

    This machine requires the player to right click the machine with a Sapling to set it to the machine.

![Tree Planter Oak Sapling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/412c1306781e1750a503b7dbb3edf4d4e0c9915f.png)

![Tree Planter Nature Particle Sapling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05db1c14c9e9e46ca03e731f987ec7c87ff07c3f.png)
    

  ### Tree Harvester

   This machine will automatically detect any crop and harvest if at full maturity. This machine will display the last thing collected and disassembled for particles.

   ![Tree Harvester Log](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92b4af6d8efab98056f11ea4954a55506b92b264.png)

![Tree Harvester Sapling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e090eb68c5382641f90e5aafbcb863db2604fb2.png)

![Tree Harvester Iron Particle Tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41965ce6d3c42f38da6984b4dcf020e307996ebe.png)
